children: SRIT India, a leading Information Technology and Information Technology-enabled services solutions company, plans to raise ₹218 crore through an initial public offering on the mainboard.
The issue, which opens on Monday, has been priced at ₹123-₹130 per equity share. The company will offer 1.68 crore equity shares in the IPO.

The net proceeds  will be used to  fund capital expenditure requirements towards modernisation of existing product development, working capital requirements, achieving inorganic growth and other strategic initiatives and general corporate purposes.
Choice Capital Advisors will be the book-running lead manager for the issue, while Kfin Technologies has been appointed the registrar.

Dr Nambiar Raghavan Madhusoodan, Managing Director & CEO, SRIT India said the company has built capabilities around designing, implementing and operating mission-critical digital platforms across e-governance, telecommunications and broadband, and healthcare.

The proposed deployment of the net proceeds towards product modernisation, working capital and strategic growth initiatives is intended to support the next phase of business as the company continues strengthening its technology capabilities and expanding its solution portfolio, he said.
Ratiraj Tibrewal, Director, Choice Capital Advisors said SRIT India has developed a track record for executing large-scale digital transformation projects for government entities and enterprises.
As of June, the company had an outstanding order book of ₹1,205 crore.
In FY26, the company’s revenue from operations was at ₹450 crore, with Operating EBITDA of ₹65 crore and PAT of ₹44 crore.

The company designs, implements and operates digital platforms for Government entities and Enterprises in India and select overseas markets. The company will be strengthening its AI capabilities through AI-enabled solutions across its core verticals and has implemented large-scale, mission-critical projects.

The company operates across three verticals electronic governance, telecommunications and broadband, and healthcare delivered through a full-service stack spanning architecture and design, build and integration, data migration, deployment and maintenance.

title: SRIT India to raise ₹218 crore via IPO on mainboard
